name: dash-pdf-components
description: React-PDF rendering components for Plotly Dash

scripts.build: pnpm run build:backends && pnpm run build:js
scripts.lint: prettier src --list-different && tsc --noEmit && uv run ruff check tests
scripts.dist: rimraf dist build dash_pdf_components.egg-info && uv build --no-sources
scripts.clean: rimraf build dist dash_pdf_components.egg-info dash_pdf_components/*.js dash_pdf_components/*.json dash_pdf_components/pdfjs dash_pdf_components/Document.py dash_pdf_components/PDF.py dash_pdf_components/Page.py dash_pdf_components/Thumbnail.py dash_pdf_components/Outline.py dash_pdf_components/_imports_.py

author: Ethan Zhang <ethan.zhang2016@gmail.com>
